rules_text:
Rules summary This BGA adaptation uses the October 2023 rules, you can download these rules from https://drive.google.com/file/d/1MQUmU_08eOhBIZXyFTW1nD0RcjiGp8fE/view . These latest rules for example do not include the 5 card combo. Contents 1 Overview 2 Turn 2.1 Special Combos 3 Cards Overview Be the last player left after all others are eliminated. Turn On your turn, you can play no cards or as many as you wish. Then, draw 1 card. If this is an Exploding Kitten and you cannot counter it in any way, you are out! Special Combos If you Play two cards of the same name, you can take a random card from someone else. If you Play three cards of the same name, you can ask for a particular card, but get nothing if that player does not have it. Cards This BGA Adaptation uses an optimized card distribution for online play. Players: 2 3 4 5 EXPLODING KITTEN 1 2 3 4 DEFUSE 3 4 6 7 ATTACK (2X) 3 4 5 6 FAVOR 1 2 4 6 NOPE 2 3 4 5 SEE THE FUTURE (3X) 3 4 4 5 SHUFFLE 2 3 4 5 SKIP 3 3 4 6 HAIRY POTATO CAT 4 4 4 4 BEARD CAT 0 4 4 4 CATTERMELON 0 0 4 4 TACOCAT 4 4 4 4 RAINBOW-RALPHING CAT 4 4 4 4

[Rating: 1/10] The game basically plays itself. You're there to hold the cards and play them when required.  No real strategy except deciding when to draw cards the rest is very obvious moves.  I can't really recommend this game for anyone unless they really like cats and bombs. The one good thing about the game is it can play relatively quickly since you don't really make any choices.  The art is funny for about the first couple of cards as it gets repetitive quite quickly.

[Rating: 1/10] Everything about this game is terrible. The art is oatmeal so I suppose that's decent. Never play this game.

[Rating: 1/10] Just because you have a successful comic does not mean you can design a board game. Sure it's funny, the first time and then never again. Sub-gateway trash with next to no meaningful decisions. Id rather play Munchkin or Monopoly. (not a good thing)

[Rating: 1/10] Rating based on 2 plays.  The player elimination element is very poorly done. Early elimination coupled with kittens on the bottom of the deck means that people were sitting around for 10+ minutes waiting for a new round. This is just poor design for a party game.  Gameplay/strategy is pretty brainless too. Draw like crazy while you have a defuse in your hand - do everything to avoid drawing when you don't.  This "game" seems to be popular merely because it is trying to be border-line offensive.   This is really just a bad game and is best avoided.

[Rating: 1/10] Fun/amusing art, little strategy and I was ready to be done with it after 20 minutes.
